manifest.description: Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs covers requirements, controlled documents, verification, risks, changes, defects, baselines and traceability.
manifest.changelog:
* Inline artefact references and campaign/suite topology membership.
* Results sync reports the campaigns it updated.
* Clearer API conflict and error responses.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Open Bloom PLM at $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN and create your administrator account.

The instance starts with no accounts, so the first visit shows a setup screen
that asks for your name, email address and a password. It stops being reachable
the moment the account exists; nobody else can claim the instance.

Email (invitations, password resets and address changes) works only if you
enabled the Email addon for this app. Without it, the administrator you create
here is the only way in.

manifest.title: Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs
manifest.description:
Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs covers requirements, controlled documents, verification, risks, changes, defects, baselines and traceability.

Assign groups of policies per project and control access by document type and origin. Review and approve controlled documents, preserve approved revisions, and link change requests to versioned changes. Import Markdown and test cases, export test cases, and generate PDF reports.
manifest.changelog:
* Request the report beside a linked Bud run and follow pending, delivered or refused status.
* Assign groups of policies per project, with separate application and access management.
* Control document access by type and origin, with independent review permissions.
* Review and approve controlled documents with notifications and email requests.
* Preserve approved content; linked approved changes advance Version and Revision on Save. Corrections keep their existing numbers.
* Upload and remove profile pictures; show them alongside users, comments and activity.
* Add a company logo to generated PDF reports.
* Import Markdown documents and test cases from CSV, XML and TestRail; export test cases and project PDF reports.
* Open linked test runs in Bud.
* Create Bloom defects from Jira issues.

manifest.title: Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs
manifest.description:
Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs covers requirements, controlled documents, verification, risks, changes, defects, baselines and traceability.

Assign groups of policies per project and control access by document type and origin. Review and approve controlled documents, preserve approved revisions, and link change requests to versioned changes. Import Markdown and test cases, export test cases, and generate PDF reports.
manifest.changelog:
* Review like a word processor: select a passage to comment on it, with replies and resolve, in a comments column beside the document.
* The document's workflow, details and metadata sit in one panel beside the text, visible without scrolling; the outline and comments collapse.
* A requirement is a title and a plain description; requirements relate through links instead of a tree.
* Visions, a document type for an idea that becomes binding once approved.
* Controlled documents have an assignee who requests review; the creator, assignee, reviewer and approver comment.
* Issue trackers sync by themselves on a schedule, and defects can be created in Jira.
* A person can hold several policy groups in one project; User Management shows each user's groups and projects.
* Every API call and every refused attempt is recorded in the audit log; access requests and the audit log name documents and people instead of showing numbers.
* Line spacing is saved per paragraph and shown everywhere the document is read.
* Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs is the product name across the application, emails and API; the BLOOM_APP_NAME environment setting no longer changes it.
* The invitation and email change dialogs close with Escape and focus their first field; project cards open with the keyboard.
* The administrator welcome email confirms the account and names the next steps; the outdated runner key paragraph is removed.
